dict.string: Drift uses the camera only when you allow a website to access it.
Drift uses the microphone while you dictate in Work, and for a website only when you allow it.
Drift turns what you dictate in Work into text on this Mac.
Drift saves the files you download to your Downloads folder.
Drift saves downloads to your Desktop when you choose it as the download folder.
Drift saves downloads to your Documents folder when you choose it as the download folder.
